Place it right after the existing '## Files' section. Add only that section; do not edit any other part of README.md, and do not modify any other file. Check: 'git diff' shows only the new section added to README.md. Commit the change.

You are a subagent: another agent started you for this one task and reads your last reply as its result. Commit your work to your branch and publish nothing: no push, no pull request. Nobody will answer a question: decide yourself, and say in your last reply what you did and what you decided.

text:
# Hello$
$
A single static page. No build step, no dependencies. It renders one centered$
greeting �M-^@M-^T "Hello, and welcome." �M-^@M-^T on a dark background, and nothing else. The$
favicon is a white "H" on a rounded square in the same dark colour as the page.$
$
## Files$
$
| Path | Purpose |$
| --- | --- |$
| `index.html` | The whole page �M-^@M-^T markup and inline styles |$
| `favicon.svg` | Favicon for modern browsers |$
| `favicon.ico` | Fallback favicon for browsers that ignore the SVG |$
$
## Run it locally$
$
Open the file directly:$
$
```sh$
open index.html$
```$
$
Or serve it over HTTP, which matches production more closely:$
$
```sh$
python3 -m http.server 8000$
# then visit http://localhost:8000$
```$
$
## Deploy$
$
Live at **https://suleimansh.github.io/test-project/**$
$
Deployment is GitHub Pages, driven by `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`. Every push to$
`main` publishes the site; it can also be run by hand from the Actions tab.$
$
One-time setup is already done on `suleimansh/test-project`: the remote exists and$
the Pages source is set to GitHub Actions (**Settings �M-^FM-^R Pages �M-^FM-^R Build and$
deployment �M-^FM-^R Source: GitHub Actions**). A fresh fork or clone needs both steps$
repeated before its first deploy will publish.$
$
Because this is a *project* Pages site, it is served from the `/test-project/`$
subpath rather than the domain root. Asset links in `index.html` are therefore$
relative (`favicon.ico`, not `/favicon.ico`) �M-^@M-^T a root-absolute path resolves to$
`suleimansh.github.io/favicon.ico` and 404s.$
$
The workflow copies only `index.html`, `favicon.ico`, and `favicon.svg` into the$
published artifact. The repository root is *not* deployed wholesale �M-^@M-^T anything not$
in that list (for example `.the-framework/`, which holds internal run logs and$
analysis notes) is never reachable from the public site. If you add a file that$
should be served, add it to the `Stage site` step or it will not ship.$
about.html
credits.html
favicon.ico
favicon.svg
index.html
node_modules
README.md
test.md
